sections.Profile:
"Joust" is a unique head-to-head pinball machine released by Williams in April 1983, designed for two players to compete simultaneously on opposing sides of the playfield. It features four flippers, no ramps, and supports a four-ball multiball mode. Designed by Barry Oursler with a total production of 402 units, it is known for its competitive gameplay and rare design.
